textExcerptSuggestion.title: How S3 Versioning works - Amazon Simple Storage Service
textExcerptSuggestion.suggestionBody: To enable versioning, you can send a request to Amazon S3 with a versioning configuration that includes an Enabled status.
textExcerptSuggestion.summary: Describes how Amazon S3 versions objects and behavior.

textExcerptSuggestion.title: Retaining multiple versions of objects with S3 Versioning - Amazon Simple Storage Service
textExcerptSuggestion.suggestionBody: For information about working with S3 Versioning, see the following topics.
textExcerptSuggestion.summary: Use versioning in Amazon S3 to keep multiple variants of an object in the same bucket.
